grammar.title: 试验成功
lines: 4 The first tests on the Solent in 1959 caused a sensation . Solent 苏伦特海峡 A narrow channel between the Isle of Wight and the southern mainland of England. The Solent provides access to the port of Southampton. 苏伦特海峡 The hovercraft travelled first over the water, then mounted the beach, climbed up the dunes, and sat down on a road. mount v.go up, ascend 登上 Later it crossed the Channel , riding smoothly over the waves , which presented no problem. ride v.When you ride in a vehicle such as a car, you travel in it. 乘坐、航行 be / pose / present a problem for … 为…构成威胁
The Solent is a narrow channel between the Isle of Wight and mainland England. 苏伦特海峡是怀特岛与英格兰大陆之间的狭窄通道。
Hovercraft tests in the Solent in 1959 were groundbreaking. 1959年在苏伦特海峡的气垫船测试具有开创性。
The Solent provides access to Southampton’s port. 苏伦特海峡为南安普敦港口提供通道。
The hovercraft mounted the beach effortlessly. 气垫船轻松登上沙滩。
He mounted the platform to address the crowd. 他登上平台向人群讲话。
A car suddenly mounted the pavement to avoid a vehicle coming in the opposite direction.
The ship mounted sixty-four bronze cannons. 这艘船装载了六十四门青铜大炮。
The death toll continues to mount . 死亡人数持续增加。
He mounted his horse and rode away. 他骑上马飞驰而去。
mount v. 将某物固定住（以备使用、展示或研究） (to fix sth. into position on sth., so that you can use it, look at it or study it) Triple gun-decks mounted sixty-four bronze cannon .

mount v. to increase gradually 逐渐增加 The death toll continues to mount . This modern faith in medicines is proved by the fact that the annual drug bill of the Health Services is mounting to astronomical figures and shows no signs at present of ceasing to rise .

mount v.（使）骑上马等 (get onto or put sb. onto a horse, etc. for riding) He quickly mounted his horse and rode away. He mounted the boy on the horse. The policemen were mounted on black horses. Two assistants, mounted on tame elephants, control the captive from either side , …
He prefers travelling on the subway to riding in a limousine. 他宁愿乘坐地铁出行而不愿乘坐豪华加长轿车。
She took some friends for a ride in the family car. 她用私家车载了朋友们一程。
Taken for a ride 乘车兜风
Racial tensions in the south of the city pose a real problem for the police. 种族紧张关系为警方构成问题。
The high rate of inflation presents a serious problem for the government. 通货膨胀为政府带来严重问题。
The waves presented no problem for the hovercraft. 波浪对气垫船没有构成问题。

be / pose / present / constitute a hazard to … 对…构成隐患 Old, frayed electrical wiring can pose a serious hazard to the safety of the entire building. 陈旧、磨损的电线可能会对整栋建筑的安全构成严重隐患。 Shallow waters pose a hazard to navigation. 浅水区对航行构成隐患。

be / pose / present / constitute a threat / menace to … 对…构成威胁 Deforestation poses a major threat to the survival of many endangered species. 森林砍伐对许多濒危物种的生存构成了重大威胁。 Extremism constitutes a threat to regional stability. 极端主义对地区稳定构成威胁。

sentences.title: 畅想未来应用场景
lines: 4 Since that time , various types of hovercraft have appeared and taken up regular service. take up v.start or begin sth, esp. a job 开始（某种工作等） service n.used to talk about whether a piece of equipment, a vehicle etc. is available to be used, or how long it can be used （设备，交通工具等）被使用，得到使用 The hovercraft is particularly useful in large areas with poor communications such as Africa or Australia; communication s n.roads, railways etc that are used for travelling and sending goods 交通 it can become a 'flying fruit-bowl', carrying bananas from the plantations to the ports ; fruit bowl n.A fruit bowl is a large bowl in which fruit is kept and displayed. 果盘 giant hovercraft liners could span the Atlantic; liner n.a large ship for passengers 客轮，班轮 span v.to stretch right across sth, from one side to the other 跨越，贯穿 and the railway of the future may well be the 'hovertrain', riding on its air cushion over a single rail, which it never touches , at speeds, up to 300 m. p. h. -- the possibilities appear unlimited. may / might / could well … used to say that sth. is like to happen or is likely to be true （某事）可能（发生或是真的） possibilities n.capability of being used or improved, potential 潜在价值，潜力 unlimited adj.as much or as many as is possible, not limited in any 无限的，无穷的 每日习语 White elephant 华而不实(负担沉重的财产，无用的东西)
She has taken up a job as a teacher. 她开始从事教师工作。
Various hovercraft have taken up regular service. 多种气垫船已开始定期服务。
He took up painting after retirement. 他退休后开始从事绘画。
These trains have been in service for many years. 这些火车已经使用多年。
The escalator is still out of service . 电梯仍在停用状态。
Hovercraft have taken up regular service in various regions. 气垫船已在多个地区开始定期服务。
Steel tools can give good service for years.
Paris has good communications with many European cities. 巴黎与许多欧洲城市有良好的交通联系。
Its commercial success as a city is partly due to its excellent rail and road communications .
Hovercraft are useful in areas with poor communications . 气垫船在交通不便的地区特别有用。
Excellent road communications boost the city’s economy. 出色的公路交通促进了城市经济。
It can become a flying fruit-bowl , carrying bananas. 它可以成为“飞行果盘”，运送香蕉。
The fruit bowl on the table was filled with tropical fruits. 桌上装满热带水果的果盘。
Hovercraft act as a fruit bowl for plantation goods. 气垫船充当种植园货物的“果盘”。
Giant hovercraft liners could span the Atlantic. 巨型气垫船客轮可以跨越大西洋。
The tragic sinking of this great liner will always be remembered, for she went down on her first voyage with heavy loss of life .
Liners revolutionized transatlantic travel. 客轮彻底改变了跨大西洋旅行。
Hovercraft liners could span the Atlantic. 气垫船客轮可以跨越大西洋。
A series of bridges span the river. 一系列桥梁跨越这条河。
Her career spanned several decades. 她的事业跨越了数十年。
Another patient might equally well complain that her neighbours were combining to slander her and persecute her, and yet one might be cautious about believing this statement .
Over the years one may well become an authority on one's hobby and will very probably be asked to give informal talks to little gatherings and then, if successful, to larger audiences .
Apart from moral considerations this is a stupid method of training, for it produces a resentful animal who at a later stage may well turn man-killer .
The railway of the future may well be the hovertrain. 未来的铁路很可能是气垫火车。
The house is very dilapidated but it has possibilities .
He was the first to see the possibilities of the plan .
The possibilities appear unlimited for hovercraft. 气垫船的潜力似乎是无限的。
He saw the possibilities of the plan early on. 他很早就看到了这个计划的潜力。
The old house has great possibilities for renovation. 这座老房子有很大的翻新潜力。
Demand for healthcare is virtually unlimited . 对医疗的需求几乎是无限的。
The new technology opens up unlimited opportunities. 新技术开启了无限的机会。
